body:
## What it does

Tracks copy and pricing changes on competitor sites alongside where you rank and whether AI answers mention you, then surfaces only the moves that need a response. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @adamta shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
